I thought nothing of it. Then Lost Boys came on. People are dancing…not the girl in front of me. Her friend looked at her with a confused look, then looked at me. I then realized…she was sitting BECAUSE OF ME! I was so sad. I proceeded to tell her that if she wants to stand, PLEASE STAND! ENJOY THE CONCERT!
